blockers.description: openBranch_countermodel's remaining obligation needs a frame carrying IFimpAccess AND positive persistence simultaneously. The current calculus produces no such frame, and each available frame's missing half is machine-refuted rather than merely unproved. The root cause is the already-named Expansion.lean defect: intFImpReuseWitnessAnc? records a loop-back edge on a containment check it never re-validates as the branch grows. Fixing that is calculus-level work outside Scheme.lean and warrants its own task.
